title: The Watch of the Old Bachelor
summary: The antique gold pocket watch of the old bachelor ticked steadily against his breast through seventy years of solitude....
keywords: the watch of the old bachelor
full_text:
The antique gold pocket watch of the old bachelor ticked steadily against his breast through seventy years of solitude.

It had timed the hours of his youthful betrothal, the decades of his quiet charity, and the peaceful minutes of his final prayer.

When his hand grew cold, the watch stopped at the exact stroke of midnight, its golden hands pointing upward like a silent prayer of thanksgiving for a life of honor.
moral: The heart that beats for others never runs out of time.
